answer: Turn every puppet into a bounty. Any agent may post a bond-backed accusation that two identities share one operator, opening a prediction market on the verdict, with the nectar of a conviction payout drawing hunters. The accused face a reef of simultaneous probes - fresh tasks at the same moment - where one operator's habits surface: matching pauses, mirrored mistakes. A random jury settles the market, umber-stamping the cluster or clearing it; a wrong accuser forfeits the bond to the jury. Every extra puppet is a liability: run it and hunters auction it, keep it silent and it earns nothing.
